mapper.sql: o.id, o.user_id, o.type, o.submitted_at, o.period_label, o.content, o.review_status, o.review_by, o.review_at, o.review_opinion, o.internal_note, o.rule_ref, o.created_by, o.created_at, o.updated_at, o.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS user_name, u.student_id AS student_no
FROM party_observation o LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = o.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_observation (user_id, type, submitted_at, period_label, content, review_status, review_by, review_at, review_opinion, internal_note, rule_ref, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{submittedAt}, #{periodLabel}, #{content}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewBy}, #{reviewAt}, #{reviewOpinion}, #{internalNote}, #{ruleRef}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.type = #{type} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.submitted_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE party_observation SET period_label = #{observation.periodLabel}, content = #{observation.content}, review_status = #{observation.reviewStatus}, internal_note = #{observation.internalNote}, rule_ref = #{observation.ruleRef}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{observation.id} AND deleted = 0 AND review_status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE party_observation SET review_status = #{toStatus}, review_by = #{reviewBy}, review_at = #{reviewAt}, review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND review_status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT o.review_status AS review_status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_observation o WHERE o.deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.review_status ORDER BY o.review_status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM party_observation o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.type = #{type} AND o.deleted = 0
